Input is an N×N sparse grid with a contiguous 3-cell horizontal marker group [A,B,C] (in demo: 6,5,3; test: 4,8,5), plus isolated endpoint cells matching colors A and C elsewhere. Draw straight orthogonal colored segments along the rows/columns to connect each marker in the group to its matching isolated same-color cell. 15x15 input contained 6,5,3 contiguous at row 0, columns 5-7; isolated 6 at (4,0), isolated 3 at (2,14).
